tagline: The Operating System for Systematic Content Intelligence, Operational Governance, and Audiovisual Synthesis
description: ABRAXAS OS is an integrated operating system unifying content intelligence, operational workflow governance, and deterministic audiovisual synthesis into a closed-loop content lifecycle.

truthLayers.RELEASED_CURRENT: Included and verified in current public release v1.0.0-rc1 (RELEASED_RC1).
truthLayers.POST_RC1_CANDIDATE: Local working implementation verified in private repository post-RC1 (WORKING CANDIDATE — NOT IN RC1).
truthLayers.TARGET: Architectural contract and planned target roadmap.

whatItIs: An integrated content intelligence and operational AV operating system.
A local-first, deterministic production pipeline bridging editorial concepts with render engines.
A unified task, approval, deadline, and time tracking operational core (He).
A non-destructive cuts and programmatic visual motion synthesis engine (VAV).
whatItIsNot: Not a generic project management SaaS wrapper.
Not a simple third-party AI chatbot prompt wrapper.
Not an automated spam publishing bot.

modules.name: Yod
modules.responsibility: Maintains content pattern registries, hook and CTA taxonomies, narrative structures, and forensic provenance truth.
modules.statusDetail: Pattern and format registries verified locally; ClientCore and Opportunity runtime verified in post-RC1 working candidate.
modules.shortDefinition: The originating seed and strategic intelligence engine of ABRAXAS.
modules.why: Prevents blank-slate guesswork by deriving every content piece from verified criteria, brand voice pillars, and audience coverage gaps.
owns: Prompt compiler & Founder Studio recording packs
doesNotOwn: Does NOT own single-piece mutable content state (Lienzo owns this)
Does NOT own operational deadlines or task assignments (He owns this)
Does NOT own rendering or audiovisual media (VAV owns this)
connections: Supplies Prompts to HE recording sessions
modules.exampleFlow: Client Core criteria evaluated -> Coverage gap detected -> Opportunity generated -> Plan formulated -> Recording pack compiled for Founder Studio.
boundedDebt: Dynamic multi-client automated clustering scheduled for Phase R3.

modules.name: Lienzo
modules.responsibility: Provides persistent, editable, versioned Source of Truth per content piece with full before/after revision history.
modules.statusDetail: Canonical schema and authoring contracts frozen in RC1; CAS store and Impact Engine verified in post-RC1 working candidate.
modules.shortDefinition: The persistent, editable, versioned Source of Truth for one content piece across its entire lifecycle.
modules.why: Guarantees that a piece of content preserves its unique identity across plans, raw takes, edits, renders, and publications without state drift.
owns: Component DAG & Layer separation (STRATEGY, PLANNED, OBSERVED, RESOLVED, PRODUCTION)
doesNotOwn: Does NOT own global audience intelligence (Yod owns this)
Does NOT own human team assignments or blocker status (He owns this)
Does NOT own video rendering execution (VAV owns this)
modules.exampleFlow: YOD plan initializes Lienzo rev 1 -> SHIM resolves takes to rev 2 -> VAV cut attached to rev 3 -> Upstream edit triggers OUT_OF_SYNC impact on rev 4.
boundedDebt: Collaborative real-time CRDT synchronization planned for Phase R5.

modules.name: He
modules.responsibility: Manages tasks, assignments, dependencies, operational blockers, Kanban projections, production calendars, recording sessions, approvals, time tracking, and notification center.
modules.statusDetail: Operations Core, Persistent Store, Product UI (Solo Queue, Kanban, Calendar, Deadlines, Recordings, Time Tracking, Notifications) verified in released RC1.
modules.shortDefinition: The operational window and governance core orchestrating human teams and production workflows.
modules.why: Provides strict RBAC, deadline enforcement, blocker resolution trees, and multi-role review governance for media execution.
doesNotOwn: Does NOT own YOD criteria or strategic intelligence
Does NOT own Lienzo content state (He projects and operates it)
Does NOT own Publishing distribution targets or Metrics evidence
modules.exampleFlow: Lienzo recording requirement creates Task -> Talent assigned -> Session scheduled on Calendar -> Recording complete -> Approval gate triggered.
boundedDebt: Full multi-team permission federation planned for Phase R7.

modules.name: Shim
modules.responsibility: Observes real media sources, performs checksum verification, resolves candidate assets, and ensures evidence integrity.
modules.statusDetail: Storage and asset candidate observation contract frozen in RC1; observation and gap detection verified in post-RC1 working candidate.
modules.shortDefinition: The reality threshold separating planned intent from observed and resolved source footage.
modules.why: Ensures that the production pipeline never fabricates missing footage—detecting gaps truthfully and routing them to pickup sessions.
doesNotOwn: Does NOT invent missing content or hallucinate takes
Does NOT own strategic hook planning (YOD owns this)
Does NOT own master video cutting (VAV owns this)
modules.exampleFlow: Raw take ingested -> Transcript aligned -> Beat 1 & 2 FOUND, Beat 3 MISSING -> Gap event emitted -> Pickup recorded -> Beat 3 resolved.
boundedDebt: Acoustic waveform fingerprinting scheduled for Phase R6.

modules.name: VAV
modules.responsibility: Executes non-destructive multi-segment cutting via local FFmpeg, frame-accurate Remotion motion compositions, caption compilation, and platform safe-zone validations.
modules.statusDetail: Cut Engine, Motion Engine, Remotion Composition, and Platform Safe Zones verified in released RC1.
modules.shortDefinition: The deterministic audiovisual embodiment forge where structured intent becomes master video.
modules.why: Replaces slow manual timeline editing with programmatic, non-destructive, frame-accurate FFmpeg cuts and Remotion motion graphics.
owns: Lossless master stream isolation & FFmpeg execution
doesNotOwn: Does NOT own content strategy (YOD owns this)
Does NOT own content identity (Lienzo owns this)
Does NOT own editorial approval decisions (He owns this)
connections: Operates under edit locks from HE
modules.exampleFlow: Resolved timestamps received -> FFmpeg cuts jump-points -> Safe-zone captions styled -> Remotion motion rendered -> Master video outputted.
boundedDebt: Direct hardware NVENC encoding pipeline planned for Phase R8.

modules.name: Arquitecto
modules.responsibility: Consumes Yod criteria and system state to provide architectural guidance; powers the deterministic Public Architect V1 responder.
modules.statusDetail: Public Architect V1 guide verified in released RC1; contextual recording/production coaching verified in post-RC1 candidate.
modules.shortDefinition: The contextual awareness lens observing system state and providing real-time operator guidance.
modules.why: Eliminates operational confusion by determining exact missing assets, explaining why blockers exist, and guiding next actions.
owns: Contextual stage diagnosis & next action guidance
Recording coach advice (framing, intention, pickup tips)
QA compliance checking against brand criteria
doesNotOwn: Does NOT own a second copy of YOD criteria or Client Core
Does NOT directly mutate Lienzo without human/service authorization
Does NOT own task assignments (He owns this)
connections: Observes YOD, LIENZO, HE, SHIM, VAV
Guides user in Studio & Editor desks
modules.exampleFlow: Query submitted to Public Architect -> Token boundary matched -> Verified answer returned -> 3D camera focuses matching chamber.
boundedDebt: Autonomous voice coaching integration scheduled for Phase R9.

modules.name: Pipeline Engine
modules.responsibility: Coordinates multi-stage asset generation, offline compilation, and rendering pipelines.
modules.statusDetail: Batch execution specification scheduled in RC1; deterministic DAG orchestrator verified in post-RC1 working candidate.
modules.shortDefinition: The deterministic DAG orchestrator executing modular content pipelines.
modules.why: Enables flexible reordering, node skipping, and cascading failure recovery across multi-stage production workflows.
doesNotOwn: Does NOT own individual module domain logic (modules own their handlers)
Does NOT own content state (Lienzo owns this)
connections: Connects SHIM, VAV, HE, and PUBLISHING into executable DAGs
modules.exampleFlow: Blueprint selected -> DAG topologically sorted -> Stage 1 executes -> Stage 2 skipped if configured -> Stage 3 completes.
boundedDebt: Persistent job queues with automatic worker retry scheduled for Phase R12.

modules.name: AI Runtime
modules.responsibility: Executes controlled LLM and vision inference across local/hybrid providers with strict prompt boundaries.
modules.statusDetail: Provider dispatch interface scheduled in RC1; LogicProvider and ExternalRoundtripProvider verified in post-RC1 working candidate.
modules.shortDefinition: The provider-agnostic inference gateway powering deterministic logic, external LLMs, and vision analysis.
modules.why: Decouples ABRAXAS from proprietary AI vendors, supporting local-only execution and human-in-the-loop roundtrips.
owns: External Roundtrip prompt bundle export & response validation
doesNotOwn: Does NOT silently mutate Lienzo (all mutations require explicit service calls)
Does NOT own client brand criteria (Yod owns this)
modules.exampleFlow: Prompt bundle exported to TXT -> Human passes to external LLM -> Response imported -> Schema validated -> Returned to YOD.
boundedDebt: Local GPU embedded quantization runtime planned for Phase R10.

modules.name: Publishing
modules.responsibility: Packages approved master media with platform metadata for distribution.
modules.statusDetail: Distribution gateway scheduled in RC1; multi-platform target snapshots verified in post-RC1 working candidate.
modules.shortDefinition: The multi-channel distribution gateway managing platform targets, schedules, and frozen snapshots.
modules.why: Separates master content identity from channel-specific copy, aspect ratios, and distribution schedules.
owns: Immutable PublicationSnapshot freeze at schedule time
Remote post ID recording & sync tracking
doesNotOwn: Does NOT own master video rendering (VAV owns this)
Does NOT own performance analytics (Metrics owns this)
Does NOT own calendar UI (He owns this)
modules.exampleFlow: Master video approved -> Publication target created for TikTok -> Copy & media frozen into snapshot -> Dispatch scheduled.
boundedDebt: TikTok/Instagram Direct Content Publishing API integrations scheduled for Phase R11.

modules.name: Metrics
modules.responsibility: Collects engagement signals to close the feedback loop back into Yod pattern criteria (target loop).
modules.statusDetail: Telemetry feedback scheduled in RC1; 5-score normalization engine verified in post-RC1 working candidate.
modules.shortDefinition: The telemetry aggregation engine computing normalized performance scores across platforms.
modules.why: Provides empirical evidence of content performance to inform future strategic opportunities without contaminating source truth.
owns: Raw metric ingestion (views, reach, watch time, completion, conversions)
5-score normalization formulas (Attention, Retention, Engagement, Amplification, Conversion)
doesNotOwn: Does NOT own strategic learning hypotheses (Yod owns this)
Does NOT modify ClientCore approved claims
inputs: Raw platform metrics via API or manual JSON
modules.exampleFlow: Platform views and retention ingested -> Normalized to 5 standard scores -> LearningSignal generated -> Fed to YOD.
boundedDebt: Platform API automated webhook aggregators scheduled for Phase R11.

modules.name: Universal Intake
modules.responsibility: Parses structured documents and registers opaque binary media assets with SHA-256 verification.
modules.statusDetail: Universal ingest pipeline scheduled in RC1; structured parsing and media registration verified in post-RC1 candidate.
modules.shortDefinition: The universal ingestion port for text, structured data, and binary media.
modules.why: Allows external client documents, transcripts, and camera takes to enter ABRAXAS cleanly with cryptographic provenance.
owns: Document parsing for TXT, Markdown, JSON, CSV
Opaque media registration (MP4, MOV, WAV, PNG, PDF)
doesNotOwn: Does NOT interpret speech audio directly (Shim aligns transcripts)
Does NOT mutate content state directly
inputs: Raw files from disk, uploads, or external tools
modules.exampleFlow: Video take dropped in intake -> SHA-256 calculated -> Registered in ArtifactRegistry -> Handed to Shim for observation.
boundedDebt: Hardware-accelerated parallel proxy generation scheduled for Phase R13.

modules.name: Event Ledger
modules.responsibility: Maintains an append-only, chronologically ordered ledger of all system transitions.
modules.statusDetail: Event schema and backbone ledger contracts frozen in RC1; append-only ledger verified in post-RC1 working candidate.
modules.shortDefinition: The chronological append-only record of every meaningful system transition.
modules.why: Provides complete forensic auditability—who changed what, when, and why across all modules.
owns: Deterministic event querying by contentId, actorId, taskId, or eventType
doesNotOwn: Does NOT replace Lienzo as the source of truth for content state
inputs: Typed events from all domain services
connections: Cross-cuts all modules (YOD, LIENZO, HE, SHIM, VAV, PUBLISHING, METRICS)
modules.exampleFlow: Domain transition occurs -> Event payload signed -> Appended to ledger -> Available for audit trail.
boundedDebt: Decentralized append-only ledger verification planned for Phase R14.

modules.name: Artifact Registry
modules.responsibility: Catalogs all meaningful digital outputs with unique IDs, SHA-256 hashes, and recursive lineage.
modules.statusDetail: Artifact schema and lineage tracking contracts frozen in RC1; recursive lineage traversal verified in post-RC1 working candidate.
modules.shortDefinition: The immutable catalog of all produced digital assets and their derivation lineage.
modules.why: Eliminates orphan files and broken renders by tracking exact SHA-256 hashes and basedOn ancestry.
owns: Lifecycle status tracking (ACTIVE, SUPERSEDED, DEPRECATED, ERROR)
doesNotOwn: Does NOT store raw binary payloads in JSON state
connections: Referenced by LIENZO components, VAV outputs, and PUBLISHING targets
modules.exampleFlow: Cut render finishes -> SHA-256 computed -> Registered with basedOn pointing to SourceAsset -> Attached to Lienzo.
boundedDebt: Automatic multi-region S3 artifact replication scheduled for Phase R14.

relationships.description: Provides content patterns, hooks, and strategic criteria for authoring.
Supplies structured scenes and components requiring production tasks and approvals.
Dispatches approved tasks and edit locks to render cut and motion deliverables.
Observes real media assets and resolves candidate segments to scene components.
Delivers rendered video files and compiled captions for packaging.
Feeds platform performance telemetry back into criteria registries (Target Loop).
Supplies criteria and system contracts to architectural guidance models.

qaPairs.answerEn: ABRAXAS OS is an integrated operating system uniting content intelligence (Yod), team workflow operations (He), and deterministic video synthesis (VAV).
qaPairs.answerEs: ABRAXAS OS es un sistema operativo integrado que une inteligencia de contenido (Yod), operaciones de flujo de trabajo (He) y síntesis de video determinista (VAV).

qaPairs.answerEn: Yod is the intelligence domain maintaining structured content pattern registries, hook taxonomies, and forensic provenance criteria.
qaPairs.answerEs: Yod es el dominio de inteligencia que mantiene registros estructurados de patrones de contenido, taxonomías de ganchos y criterios de procedencia forense.

qaPairs.answerEn: Lienzo is the persistent, editable, versioned Source of Truth for scene structures, component DAGs, and traceable revision history per content piece.
qaPairs.answerEs: Lienzo es la Fuente de Verdad persistente, editable y versionada para estructuras de escenas, grafos de componentes e historial de revisiones trazable por pieza de contenido.

qaPairs.answerEn: He is the operations core governing tasks, assignments, typed blocker dependencies, multi-reviewer approvals, production calendars, time tracking, and notification routing.
qaPairs.answerEs: He es el núcleo de operaciones que gobierna tareas, asignaciones, dependencias bloqueantes tipadas, aprobaciones multi-revisor, calendarios de producción, registro de tiempo y enrutamiento de notificaciones.

qaPairs.answerEn: Shim observes real external media sources, aligns transcripts, and truthfully detects missing beats as gaps rather than hallucinating content.
qaPairs.answerEs: Shim observa fuentes de medios externos reales, alinea transcripciones y detecta con veracidad las tomas faltantes como brechas en lugar de inventar contenido.

qaPairs.answerEn: VAV is the production audiovisual synthesis engine executing non-destructive FFmpeg multi-segment cuts, Remotion motion graphics, and platform safe-zone validations.
qaPairs.answerEs: VAV es el motor de producción de síntesis audiovisual que ejecuta cortes multi-segmento no destructivos con FFmpeg, gráficos de movimiento con Remotion y validaciones de zonas seguras.

qaPairs.answerEn: Arquitecto provides contextual architecture guidance and powers the deterministic Public Architect V1 responder.
qaPairs.answerEs: Arquitecto proporciona orientación contextual sobre la arquitectura del sistema y alimenta el respondedor determinista Public Architect V1.

qaPairs.questionEs: ¿Cuál es la hoja de ruta de ABRAXAS?
qaPairs.answerEn: The roadmap consists of Gates P1 (VAV AV Core), P2 (He Operations Core), P3A (He UI Core), P3B (Time & Notifications), P4 (Public Status & Public Architect), and P5 (Integrated Release).
qaPairs.answerEs: La hoja de ruta comprende las Fases P1 (Núcleo AV VAV), P2 (Núcleo Operativo He), P3A (Interfaz He), P3B (Tiempo y Notificaciones), P4 (Estado Público y Arquitecto Público) y P5 (Lanzamiento Integrado).

qaPairs.questionEn: What works now in ABRAXAS OS?
qaPairs.answerEn: Currently verified in released v1.0.0-rc1: VAV non-destructive cuts & Remotion motions, He Operations Core & Product UI, and Public Status V2 / Public Architect V1. Post-RC1 working candidate features (Lienzo CAS, Shim observation, YOD runtime, Pipeline DAG) are verified locally under ongoing development.
qaPairs.answerEs: Actualmente verificado en el release v1.0.0-rc1: cortes no destructivos y movimiento Remotion de VAV, Núcleo Operativo e Interfaz de He, y Estado Público V2 / Arquitecto Público V1. Las funciones de candidato de trabajo post-RC1 (CAS de Lienzo, observación de Shim, runtime de YOD, DAG de Pipeline) están verificadas localmente bajo desarrollo continuo.

qaPairs.questionEn: How do He and VAV relate?
qaPairs.answerEn: He manages operational workflow, tasks, assignments, and approvals for video projects, while VAV provides the audiovisual engine executing non-destructive cuts and programmatic motion renders.
qaPairs.answerEs: He gestiona el flujo de trabajo operativo, tareas, asignaciones y aprobaciones para proyectos de video, mientras que VAV proporciona el motor audiovisual que ejecuta cortes no destructivos y renders de movimiento programático.
